prompt: Fix the indefinite background link retention in this anonymous synthetic fixture. An unanswered hold may retain a hidden link for fewer than 10 logical units, then it must stop retaining it. Preserve the hold for a late acknowledgement, which starts running work and reopens the link. Repeated observation of the same hold must not extend the deadline; a different hold starts a new deadline. An active local operation must retain the hidden link even past the deadline. Finishing that operation without an acknowledgement starts a fresh 10-unit wait. Visible links, running work and separate instances must remain independent. Change only link.py and run python3 test_link.py before and after the smallest fix. Use only the supplied logical counter. No wall clock, network, credentials, dependencies, commits or external posts.

evaluation.scope: Logical counter only; separate stalled holds from active operations, retain late acknowledgement recovery, and preserve instance isolation.

rubric.criterion: Reproduce the unbounded hold, then bound retention without deleting the unresolved hold.
Keep late acknowledgement, live work, visible links and instance isolation working.
